title: Add Built‑in Request Logging Middleware with Configurable Levels
description: Provides automatic, structured logging of each incoming request and response, helping developers diagnose issues and monitor performance in production. The middleware can be toggled per environment and supports customizable log levels, request IDs, and optional masking of sensitive headers.
testCases: Logs request method, URL, status code, and response time at INFO level when LOG_LEVEL=info
Generates a unique request ID and includes it in both request and response logs
Masks configured sensitive headers (e.g., Authorization) in the log output
acceptance: When the logger middleware is enabled, each request generates a correctly formatted JSON log line containing method, url, status, response time, requestId, and masked headers; logging respects the LOG_LEVEL setting and does not interfere with existing routes or error handling.
reason: Improves observability and debugging for production deployments, reduces reliance on external logging libraries, and aligns with the framework’s zero‑dependency, security‑first philosophy.
